report: Xullorax 97388, spawn 375069 on map 1502, left a blank uncollectable loot slot after Maiko collected 29 gold.
evidence: Creature loot 97388 contains Item=0, Currency=1149, MinCount=MaxCount=64, Chance=99.9331. Native 7.3.5 CurrencyTypes.db2 identifies 1149 as Sightless Eye, icon 801132, cap 5000. This currency has valid client data; it is not a missing quest item.

LootItem copies Item and Currency into distinct fields. Loot::BuildLootResponse incorrectly populated LootCurrency.CurrencyID from ItemID, which is zero for currency rows. LootResponse::Write serialized that zero unchanged.

Player::StoreLootItem already validates and awards item.CurrencyID, so only the response projection was wrong. The corpse's generated loot was not packet-captured; the guaranteed-near currency row and reproduced ID-zero response match the reported symptom.
repair: Populate LootCurrency.CurrencyID from item.item.CurrencyID. Preserve currency amount, slot mapping, visibility, collection rules, ordinary items and all loot tables.
